notes:
CRM notes (shorthand):
- Company: mid-market SaaS (product analytics) building contextual in-app assistant + semantic search. Started on Hosted API to accelerate dev.
- POC learnings: host API fine for rapid iteration; cost and egress predictability drove interest to Dedicated with VPC. Team observed token cost variance on burst workloads.
- Technical requirements: low-latency chat (p95 < 200ms ideal; product target 100ms p95 for UI), embeddings at steady 150–300 qps for search indexing, reranking within 50ms budget per request.
- Model preferences: prefer open-chat models (Llama2/Mistral variants) with ability to route to quantized variants for cost SLOs. Need fallback policy to smaller model when Dedicated capacity saturated.
- Security/compliance: "must" items — SOC2 Type II evidence, SSO via Okta (SAML), audit logging for all inference requests (tokenized request_id, user_id persistence rules), KMS integration for keys, data residency US-only for PII workloads, retention controls with configurable default 90 days and ability to reduce.
- Network: require VPC peering + private egress; prefer private endpoint for Dedicated control plane. Ops asked about IP ranges and egress firewall rules.
- Ops/Cost: product org wants a predictable node commit (monthly) plus burst capacity for launch. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and KV prefix caching to shave token spend.
- Quotes/phrases from stakeholders: "If we can't prove logs are ephemeral and 90 days max, legal won't sign." — Dir. Product; "Okta SSO is mandatory for all Prod access." — Head of IT.
- Reference artifacts: pricing proposal (drive link), security evidence pack stub (drive link), Fireflies call transcripts attached.
- Next steps (short): architecture review (SE + network), SOC2 artifacts handoff to security reviewer, finalize Dedicated node sizing and commit, legal to review contract after security signoff.
- Sales/eng notes: prepare example JMX for p95 latency with 8xA10G config and fallback to 4xA10G small cluster. Provide clear SLA language for Dedicated and fallback routing behavior.
- Misc: possible competitive push from OpenAI (pricing) — highlight quantization + routing cost controls in deck.
